body.x: Omron participated in ‘CES 2018(Consumer Technology Show)’, the world’s largest IT consumer electronics show held in Las Vegas, the U.S.A. from Tues. 9th to Fri. 12th in Jan. and introduced a smart ping-pong ball pickup robot.

Omron has developed products that imagine the future of more than 40 years later. This company is a leader in health and health technology. This company provides a very accurate and clinically proven direct tool for people to leave their health. The product showed at CES this year was a robot that collects ping-pong balls and an artificial robot that teaches ping-pong to people. With such robots, people can play ping-pong easily and efficiently.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
